reproduce_sh: run from the repository root; all steps completed

latex.compiler: sources: pdflatex (latexmk -pdf) with lmodern + microtype; distributed PDFs: XeLaTeX with the Latin Modern OpenType fonts (all fonts embedded with Unicode maps)
latex.bibliography_order: numbered in order of first citation (checked by script)

limitations: Historical full scans and the 960-step Lanczos calculation are not rerun by reproduce.sh.
Numerical agreement is not a machine proof of the analytical arguments.
No positivity proof or convergence rate at the specific infinite-mode cutoffs 0.4 and 0.6.
Standalone Figure 5 source and PDF retained byte-identically from v10.10; all figures in the two manuscripts were recompiled.
